title: Application repository identity
responsibility: Identifies a checkout by its normalized network origin or canonical local Git store, follows bounded local-clone origins, and compares repository or plain-site membership.

inputs.name: repositoryIdentity.directory
inputs.description: Checkout directory identified through its selected upstream or canonical local Git store.

inputs.name: sameSite.site
inputs.description: Site directory whose repository identity or exact plain-directory path defines membership.

inputs.name: sameSite.directory
inputs.description: Candidate directory whose membership in the site is tested.

outputs.name: repositoryIdentity
outputs.description: SHA-256 of the normalized network origin or canonical local store after at most five local-origin hops; null when identity is missing or ambiguous.

outputs.name: sameRepository
outputs.description: True only when both directories resolve to the same non-null repository identity.

outputs.name: sameSite
outputs.description: True for a checkout of the same known site repository or the exact canonical directory of a non-Git site; unknown repository origin is not path-matched.
